items.title: Git workflow plugin
items.goal: Settle the conceptual approach of the agentic-os git-workflow plugin that replaces the old single-repo and monorepo workflows.

items.title: Move the duplicated remote slug helper of release.sh and promote.sh into one plugin library
items.goal: release.sh and promote.sh each parse the remote origin into an owner/name slug and an https URL with the same code; one library function serves both, so a change of the rule cannot make the two commands disagree. The review finding 5 of T3.6 recorded the duplication.
